subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: After the three guard assertions and merge conflict are fixed, should the security-owned workflows accept these verified official action revisions?
rationale: Several revisions execute with app private keys, registry credentials, OpenAI API keys, publishing rights, or SARIF permissions; the protected security label and CODEOWNERS require explicit acceptance.

options.title: Approve after repairs
options.body: Accept the verified revisions after assertions match and exact-head checks pass on a conflict-free branch.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Review Codex, app-token, Docker, and CodeQL revisions in narrower security-owned pull requests.

options.title: Pause grouped bump
options.body: Recreate or close this branch if Dependabot cannot preserve repairs through rebase.

recommendation.title: Approve after repairs
recommendation.body: Accept the verified revisions after assertions match and exact-head checks pass on a conflict-free branch.
